title: Canonical tensor-pullback comparison along a scheme cone
statement: Let $I$ be a small preordered set, let $D:I^{\mathrm{op}}\to\mathit{Sch}$ be an inverse diagram of schemes [def-pc-scheme], and let $c=(Z,(q_i)_i)$ be a cone on $D$, so that for every $h:i\leq j$ the transition $q_{ji}=D(h^{\mathrm{op}}):D_j\to D_i$ satisfies $q_j;q_{ji}=q_i$. For an $\mathcal O_{D_i}$-module $M$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], define the canonical comparison $$\operatorname{cmp}_{c,h,M}:q_j^*(q_{ji}^*M)\xrightarrow{\sim}q_i^*M.$$ All pullbacks are tensor pullbacks [def-pc-module-pullback]. This comparison is the inverse of the section-normalized canonical composition isomorphism $(q_j;q_{ji})^*M\xrightarrow{\sim}q_j^*q_{ji}^*M$, followed by equality transport along the cone equation $q_j;q_{ji}=q_i$. The composition isomorphism is induced by the tensor-pullback adjunction whose unit sends every local section $m$ to $1\otimes m$. No directedness, limit property, quasi-compactness, affineness, or finite presentation is needed for this definition.

def affineLimitTensorPullbackComparison
    {I : Type u} [Preorder I] (D : Iᵒᵖ ⥤ Scheme.{u}) (c : Cone D)
    {i j : I} (hij : i ≤ j) (M : (D.obj (op i)).Modules) :
    (tensorPullback (c.π.app (op j))).obj
        ((tensorPullback (D.map (homOfLE hij).op)).obj M) ≅
      (tensorPullback (c.π.app (op i))).obj M
